request.state: The ongoing migration found another repeated candidate: generic history_open:bool=false, its label binding and a details/history wrapper would be copied in multiple apps. The original draft corpus already has 46 canonical history controls. Adoption/token efficiency require common setup once. History remains currently authorized, bounded and field-projected; no preference may change grants, queries, retention or business state. Proposed default: canonical history renders one runtime-labeled Collapse, initially closed, with a shared own-user Appearance choice for initial history expansion. Authenticated choice is shared base presentation state; anonymous choice stays browser-local. This requires no new authored syntax. Domain evidence groups and app-specific presentation differences still use existing details/preferences when actually needed. Renderer/base settings remain unimplemented.

placement.instructions: Which canonical placement fits the repeated history choice and the given authorization/token constraints?

criteria.shared: Put the common history expansion choice in runtime Appearance and derive each history control without copied schema/labels/wrapper; accept one standard behavior.
criteria.per_owner: Declare each owner history preference and bind wrappers; accept repeated setup for independently scoped choice.
criteria.omit: Offer no persistent expansion choice and keep history initially closed; accept losing this personal behavior.

boundary.instructions: Does the shared-choice proposal preserve current history disclosure and business behavior when its only effect is initial expansion of the same authorized control?
